name: InterContinental Kuala Lumpur
positioning: City-centre InterContinental on Jalan Ampang, steps from the Twin Towers and the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, with a landscaped level-5 pool and a Club InterContinental lounge
best_for: Travelers who want a base steps from the Twin Towers and the Convention Centre
Guests who value club lounge access and a garden-style pool in the city

facts.text: InterContinental Kuala Lumpur is steps away from the Twin Towers, the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, and shopping and entertainment.
The hotel is at 165 Jalan Ampang, Kuala Lumpur.
The hotel lists Ampang Park LRT Station and Persiaran KLCC MRT Station as nearby public transportation.
Rooms offer a Super King-sized bed or two super single twin beds, plus a working space with a multi-media hub.
Complimentary self parking is available daily.
The hotel's spa is Jade Heritage Spa, with treatments including facials and foot reflexology.
The hotel hosts events in nine venues and two pillarless ballrooms.
Serena Brasserie is set amid a koi garden with a cascading waterfall and serves buffet spreads and an a la carte menu of local and international dishes.
OneSixFive Lounge serves signature Royal High Tea sets with Beef Wellington and pastries, paired with fine teas.
The hotel is single-use plastic free.
Children's activities are offered on site.

highlights.text: The outdoor pool is on level 5, surrounded by lush green landscaping, with a pool bar serving cold drinks.
The Club InterContinental lounge gives guests with access enhanced benefits.
Rooms have a large marble bathroom with a separate shower and bathtub.
Tatsu Japanese Cuisine blends Japanese aesthetics with a contemporary, minimalist design across its sushi bar, teppanyaki counter and main dining room.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
The Club InterContinental lounge has a smart casual dress code with appropriate footwear.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with city traffic and noise.
